summary: This is a Form 6-K report of foreign private issuer Karooooo Ltd., filed to disclose the results of its Annual General Meeting held on July 28, 2026. Shareholders voted on routine items (reappointment of director, adoption of financial statements, auditor reappointment, and non-executive director remuneration) and special business authorizing share repurchases and share issuance. All resolutions passed with strong majority support. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change. This is a routine meeting report, not a special situation.
